scenes.text: This tutorial covers Plaque assay. Measure plaque formation and condition-dependent changes from plate images.
Open Plaque assay from the Toxoplasma assays section. Provide plaque images, plate layout, pixel calibration, conditions, and controls.
In the main configuration area, configure background correction, thresholding, object cleanup, plaque-size filters, and well grouping.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. verify segmentation overlays across control and treatment wells before batch analysis.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR reports plaque counts, areas, summaries, statistics, and quality-control figures.
